         AETHIOPS MINERALIS

       Sulph and Quicksilver, or Black Sulphide Mercury

      (AETHIOPS MERCURIALIS-MINERALIS)


This preparation is of use in   scrofulous
      affections, ophthalmia, otorrhœa, painful, irritating, scabby eruptions, hereditary syphilis.



Skin.--  Eruptions. Favus-like, scrofulous, herpetic and
      eczematous.



Relationship.--    Aethiops Antimonalis  --(Hydrargyrum
      stibiato sulfuratum).--(often more effective than the above in scrofulous eruptions, glandular
      swellings, otorrhœa and   scrofulous eye affections  ,
      corneal ulcers. Third trituration). Compare:   Calc; Sil; Psorin  .



Dose.--  The lower triturations, especially the second decimal.
